baek_kit.note: All 276 name records of Baek Doo San's Tekken 6 PSP COM decode, grouped to the 81 unique commands the v3 (round-15 notation) revision decoded from the in-record glyphs. The 276 records are multi-language name strings for the same moves, not 276 distinct moves. 14 records carry no glyph command in their string and are listed undecoded, not guessed.

baek_rebuild.owner_instruction: gave everyone's moves correct. All the moves and inputs need to be correct.
method: Replaced the T3 Bryan proxy bank with real Baek Doo San data: the in-repo Tekken 6 PSP COM decode (teardown/tekken6/movesets/t6psp-baek-doo-san-moveset-v3.json, 276 records / 81 unique commands) as the baek_kit layer, plus the TTT2 Baek movelist (game/assets/ttt2/movesets/bae.json; 153 moves already carried in baek-master-white.json).

Every playable row carries a REAL Baek name+input. Frame/damage/anim come from the T3 Hwoarang bank (Taekwondo — the closest T3 bank, verified: t3-hwoarang.json, 723 moves, t3_source hwoarang, anim_bank hwoarang) on the same input, disclosed per row — the same proxy-bank pattern the 2026-11-06 wang_rebuild record sanctions for Byou (Jin bank). No Baek frame/anim bank exists in holdings, so no Baek frames or anims were invented.

Commands with no same-input Hwoarang row stay kit-only data (playable_entry false), never invented. WH-original signatures preserved verbatim. stance_after stays empty: no Baek stance table exists in sources (same gap the wang_rebuild records for Wang). hit_words dropped: keyed to the old Bryan inputs and unsourceable for the new rows.

removed_bryan_layer.where_bryan_lives: Bryan's own banks are untouched: game/assets/movesets/skull.json (688 moves) and retsu.json. Nothing was lost from the repo.

gaps: No Baek frame data or damage exists in any source held (the T6 PSP COM decode yields names + glyph commands only; the TTT2 movelist yields names + inputs + throw escapes only).

No Baek animation bank exists in holdings (T6 MOTA motion chunks are listed but not decoded; TTT2 motbin extraction pending per the baek-master-white row notes). Playable rows therefore run Hwoarang motion, disclosed per row.
38 of 81 T6 commands have no same-input Hwoarang row (mostly long Flamingo strings, e.g. 3,3,3,4 Butterfly Kicks) and are kit-only until a Baek motion/frame source lands.
TTT2 Baek rows upgraded with Hwoarang proxy anim/frames where a same-input row exists: 23 of 153; the remaining 130 stay no-anim kit data.

T6 commands skipped as playable rows (input already covered by a TTT2 row): ['1+3', '1,1', '2+4', '2,2', '2,3', 'b+1', 'd+2', 'd/b+1+3', 'd/b+2', 'd/f+1,3', 'd/f+3+4', 'f+1+3', 'f+2+3', 'f+2+4', 'u/f+2'].
Pre-existing merge artifact untouched: the 24 wh: rows include donor.baek duplicates of the two Baek signatures (merge_sources.py 2026-10-23); dedup is a separate lane's job.
